premise: The supply pod, the lander and the rocket all want the one landing pad at once; Pilot has them take turns, and the biggest waits longest.
inspiration: Three Billy Goats Gruff (Norwegian folk tale), turned: no troll at all — just one pad, and turns, and the big one learns to wait.
lesson: Taking turns is fair, whatever your size.

en-US.title: One Pad, Three Ships
en-US.text: There was one landing pad, and three ships wanted it, all at once. {supply-pod:enter} Me first! puffed the supply pod. I'm the smallest! {pilot:enter} {pilot:live} Pilot waved his glowing wands. One at a time, please. {supply-pod:go to pad} {canvas:dust 4s} Down came the pod, in a little puff of dust. {supply-pod:live} Its lid popped open: parcels out. {supply-pod:go away} And off it went again. {lander:enter} Me next! said the lander. I'm the middle-sized one! {lander:go to pad} {pilot:face happy} Down it came, gold and gleaming. {lander:live} Hatch open, crew out. {lander:go away} And off it went. [pause] All this time, the biggest ship had been waiting up in the sky, rumbling. {pilot:face surprised} Your turn, said Pilot, to the {rocket:enter} rocket. {rocket:go to pad} Down it came, the biggest of all, {rocket:live} its engines rumbling in a great cloud of dust. {pilot:face happy} {pilot:hop} Three ships, one pad, no fuss. [happily] Just turns.

es-ES.title: Una plataforma, tres naves
es-ES.text: Había una sola plataforma de aterrizaje, y tres naves la querían a la vez. {supply-pod:enter} ¡Yo primero! resopló la cápsula de carga. ¡Soy la más pequeña! {pilot:enter} {pilot:live} Piloto movió sus bastones luminosos. De una en una, por favor. {supply-pod:go to pad} {canvas:dust 4s} Bajó la cápsula, en una nubecita de polvo. {supply-pod:live} Se le abrió la tapa: fuera paquetes. {supply-pod:go away} Y se volvió a marchar. {lander:enter} ¡Ahora yo! dijo el módulo lunar. ¡Soy el mediano! {lander:go to pad} {pilot:face happy} Bajó él, dorado y reluciente. {lander:live} Escotilla abierta, tripulación fuera. {lander:go away} Y se marchó. [pause] Mientras tanto, la nave más grande había esperado allá arriba, retumbando. {pilot:face surprised} Te toca, le dijo Piloto al {rocket:enter} cohete. {rocket:go to pad} Bajó el más grande de todos, {rocket:live} con los motores retumbando en una gran nube de polvo. {pilot:face happy} {pilot:hop} Tres naves, una plataforma, ni un lío. [happily] Solo turnos.
